description: This file contains implementation of quantized pooling operations (max pooling) for CPU in PyTorch, including 2D and 3D variants, with support for different memory formats and optional QNNPACK acceleration.

classes.name: QMaxPool_arr_args<1>

classes.description: Template class for selecting max pooling implementation based on spatial dimension.

methods.description: Performs 2D max pooling using QNNPACK backend if available.

methods.description: Main function for quantized 2D max pooling, dispatches to QNNPACK or native implementation.

methods.name: quantized_max_pool3d
